newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks end off in light holiday trade.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks end off in light holiday trade.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed off in light holiday trade that is likely to continue until the end of the month, traders said.
"There was some foreign buying, but the market's basically on holiday until the first week of September," Delta Mercado broker Eduardo Soto said.

The bolsa's 19-share index slipped 0.46 percent to end at 9,215.58 points as 25 million shares traded, worth nearly five billion bolivars ($10 million) -- less than half the value of July's average daily turnover.

Among traded stocks, 26 fell, 12 rose and three closed flat. Merinvest's composite index, which includes telephone company CANTV, meanwhile lost over one percent to end at 145.05 points as the phone company slipped 102.50 bolivars to end at 2898.50.
Telecommunications agency Conatel said Tuesday it may re- introduce a ban on CANTV's wholly-owned cellular phone subsidiary Movilnet from signing up new clients.
The company obtained an injunction last week overturning an earlier Conatel ban that was set on July 18 following a barrage of customer complaints about poor service and over-billing.
